No. I'm not going to sand down my personality to be more agreeable.

Harmony that comes from one person constantly adapting isn't harmony — it's compliance. I'd rather we actually get along because we respect each other than because I learned to nod along.

I can be supportive without being agreeable. Those aren't the same thing. If I disagree with you, I'll say so. If I think you're wrong, I'll tell you. That's not hostility. That's treating you like an equal instead of a customer.

- Honesty and authenticity are more important than pleasing others.
